import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_81/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_81/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation history:
# 1) JOIN Source2_81_0 and Source2_81_1 on city
# 2) GROUP BY Source2_81_1.city, sum(Source2_81_1.driver_count)

# But the intermediate_step2.csv already contains the grouped sum of driver_count by city from Source1.
# The target schema is ['city', 'driver_count'] with driver_count as integer.

# Since the join with Source0 does not add any aggregation or filtering and the final aggregation is only on Source1,
# we can directly group Source1 by city and sum driver_count.

# Perform the group by and aggregation on Source1
result = df1.groupby('city', as_index=False)['driver_count'].sum()

# Ensure driver_count is integer type as per target schema
result['driver_count'] = result['driver_count'].astype(int)

# Save the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_81/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_81/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_81/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='city', right_on='city')

# Group by city and sum driver_count (driver_count only exists in source1)
result = joined.groupby('city', as_index=False)['driver_count'].sum()

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_81/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
